text:
QUOTE: Items 2, 3: "If it is the current channel, kick the user (`handleKickFromChannel`), and always `removeCurrentUserFromChannel`" when `'false'`; "Channel stays in local DB with `delete_at` set" when viewable.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that when archived channels aren't viewable the user is removed (and kicked if current), and when viewable the channel stays with delete_at set (marked deleted).
